title: IntentKey Takes Identity-Free CTV Targeting to the Neighborhood Level
summary: Discover how IntentKey advances CTV targeting with neighborhood-level audience intelligence for greater privacy, adaptability, and expanded reach.
body_markdown:
Connected TV (CTV) advertising is approaching a major milestone.[EMARKETER forecasts that U.S. CTV ad spending will surpass linear TV in 2027](https://www.emarketer.com/chart/c/352254/connected-tv-ctv-ad-spending-will-surpass-linear-tv-2027-billions-us-linear-tv-ctv-ad-spending-ctv-of-converged-tv-ad-spending-2024-2028-352254?utm_source=chatgpt.com) , marking a significant shift in TV advertising investment.


As premium streaming inventory becomes increasingly accessible programmatically, advertisers face a **growing challenge: reaching relevant audiences with greater precision without increasing their dependence on personal data.**


Inuvo’s latest advancement in[IntentKey](https://inuvo.com/technology/) addresses that challenge, **bringing real-time audience intelligence to the neighborhood level** while preserving consumer privacy.


## More Precise CTV Targeting Doesn’t Require More Personal Data


Traditional CTV targeting relies on household profiles, IP addresses, or device identifiers to associate impressions with audiences. As identity-dependent signals become less reliable and available, these approaches face growing limitations in reflecting real-time consumer intent.


IntentKey takes a different approach.


By analyzing real-time content consumption patterns across the open web, IntentKey identifies emerging consumer interests **without requiring first-party customer data, cookies, or persistent personal identifiers.**


Its latest algorithm introduces **temporary, neighborhood-level intent models** , adding geographic precision to its existing audience intelligence. These models evolve with shifting consumer interests, informing CTV advertising decisions based on where demand is emerging rather than historical household profiles.


As **Amir Bakhshaie, Senior Vice President, IntentKey at Inuvo** , explains:


> ZIP-code intelligence has been an important part of how IntentKey understands consumer interests geographically. We’re now adding another layer of intelligence that continuously models how those interests vary within neighborhoods. By combining these signals in real time, we can help advertisers reach relevant CTV audiences without needing to identify or track individual consumers.


## Three Advantages of Identity-Free CTV Targeting


IntentKey’s neighborhood-level advancement delivers three key advantages:


### Privacy Without Persistent Profiles


Short-lived neighborhood models capture local consumer interests without building persistent profiles of individuals or households, preserving anonymity while enabling more precise targeting.


### Real-Time Adaptability


Neighborhood models are continuously created and reevaluated as interests evolve, keeping audience intelligence current and advertising decisions aligned with emerging demand.


### Expanded Reach Across CTV


Removing the dependency on consumer identities opens access to prospective audiences across CTV inventory that traditional identity-based targeting overlooks.


The new algorithm is already operating at scale. In October alone, it served more than **20 million impressions** , with performance consistent with IntentKey’s existing targeting algorithms, demonstrating its ability to support real-world CTV campaigns.


## How Neighborhood-Level Audience Intelligence Benefits Advertisers Across Industries


ZIP codes often span large, diverse areas with varying consumer interests and purchase intent. IntentKey’s neighborhood-level intelligence adds precision within those areas, automatically evaluating local intent signals against an advertiser’s audience model to inform more relevant CTV placements.


### Automotive: Year-End Inventory and New Model Launches


As regional automotive groups promote outgoing inventory and introduce new models, IntentKey identifies emerging interest in luxury vehicles, family SUVs, or EVs within the same market, helping align CTV impressions with relevant prospective buyers.


### Nonprofit: Year-End Fundraising


For nonprofits focused on donor acquisition, neighborhood-level intelligence identifies emerging interest in causes like food insecurity, animal welfare, or disaster relief, reaching prospective supporters beyond existing donor lists and lookalike audiences.


### Tourism: Winter Travel and Seasonal Demand


As travelers explore ski destinations, winter getaways, and holiday experiences, IntentKey detects shifting local interest, helping destination marketers reach audiences aligned with their offerings.


Across these industries, targeting decisions adapt automatically as consumer demand evolves, keeping campaigns aligned with current interests rather than static audience assumptions.


## Beyond CTV: Extending Audience Intelligence Across Programmatic Channels


IntentKey’s concept-based audience models extend across online video, display, and streaming audio, supporting a consistent cross-channel strategy that adapts to emerging consumer interests without relying on persistent cross-device identities.


Combined with access to premium CTV inventory and Inuvo’s Programmatic Lift Analysis for measuring performance and identifying optimization opportunities, advertisers gain a connected approach to audience targeting, activation, and measurement.


As CTV investment grows, IntentKey demonstrates how **greater precision, broader reach, and consumer privacy can advance together.**

## Frequently Asked Questions


### 1. What is neighborhood-level CTV targeting?


Neighborhood-level CTV targeting uses localized audience intelligence to identify emerging consumer interests within geographic areas smaller than traditional ZIP codes. IntentKey analyzes real-time content consumption patterns to inform more precise advertising decisions without relying on individual consumer identities.


### 2. How does IntentKey target CTV audiences without personal identifiers?


IntentKey analyzes content consumption patterns across the open web to identify emerging consumer interests. Its short-lived neighborhood models continuously evaluate these signals, enabling relevant CTV targeting without requiring cookies, device IDs, first-party customer data, or persistent household profiles.


### 3. What are the benefits of identity-free CTV targeting?


Identity-free CTV targeting offers three key advantages: privacy, adaptability, and expanded reach. Advertisers can reach relevant audiences without persistent consumer profiles, respond to changing interests through continuously updated models, and access CTV inventory that identity-dependent targeting approaches overlook.


### 4. How does neighborhood-level audience intelligence improve CTV advertising?


Neighborhood-level intelligence adds geographic precision to CTV targeting by identifying variations in consumer interest within broader ZIP-code areas. IntentKey automatically evaluates these signals against an advertiser’s audience model to inform relevant advertising opportunities as consumer demand evolves.


### 5. Can IntentKey’s CTV audience intelligence be used across other programmatic channels?


Yes. IntentKey’s concept-based audience models support targeting across CTV, online video, display, and streaming audio. Advertisers can extend a consistent audience strategy across these channels while adapting to real-time consumer interests without relying on persistent cross-device identities.
